meta.title: Pricing | Free for Founding Members, Pay-As-You-Go and Puntr Pro
meta.description: Puntr is free for the first 100 Founding Members. Puntr Pro adds deeper sports analysis, advanced Tipster tools and Tipster Support extras from 1 December 2026.
meta.ogTitle: Puntr pricing: free for Founding Members
meta.ogDescription: Claim one of 100 Founding spots. Posting, voting and the leaderboard are always free.

title: Pricing
subtitle: Start free as a Founding Member. Optional Pay-As-You-Go credits and Puntr Pro are planned for the official launch on 1 December 2026.

founding.title: Your place in the founding community
founding.f1: A permanent Founding badge, numbered #1 to #100
founding.f2: Full access to posting, your record and the weekly leaderboard from launch on 1 December 2026
founding.f3: 30 free Pay-As-You-Go credits a month for 3 months once they launch

never: Paying never buys points, a higher ranking or prize eligibility. Verified Tipsters who unlock Tipster Support may receive PuntPoints from members who back them.

faq.title: Pricing questions
faq.a1: Yes. Founding Members use Puntr free. Posting, voting and the leaderboard are always free.
faq.q2: When do Pay-As-You-Go and Puntr Pro launch?
faq.a2: Both are available from the official launch on 1 December 2026. We will confirm final prices and terms before anything goes on sale. The prices here are indicative.
faq.q3: What is the difference between Pay-As-You-Go and Puntr Pro?
faq.a3: Pay-As-You-Go lets you purchase credits when you need an eligible extra. Puntr Pro adds deeper analysis, additional tools and Tipster Support extras: back up to 10 tipsters instead of 2, and pay no platform fee on support you receive.
faq.a4: No. Payment does not buy points, improve your position on the leaderboard or change prize eligibility. Rankings are based on recorded performance.
faq.a5: No. Puntr does not take bets, set odds or hold betting funds.

payg.title: Pay-As-You-Go
payg.tagline: Buy credits only when you need them. No subscription.
payg.note: Indicative prices. They may change before launch.
payg.alwaysFree: Posting, voting and the leaderboard are always free.

pro.title: Puntr Pro
pro.tagline: For sports fans and Tipsters who want deeper analysis, stronger tools and recognition for a consistent track record.
pro.note: Tipster Support is open to every verified member who wins 10 picks in a row; Pro adds capacity and removes the 10% platform fee. Support is paid in PuntPoints, not cash; points cannot be withdrawn and never affect rankings.
pro.f1: <1>Planned AI-powered insights</1>: match previews and slip checks
pro.f2: Advanced tipster analytics: units, ROI and form by market, sport and odds range
pro.f3: Custom alerts for fixtures and settled picks you follow
pro.f5: A Pro badge on your profile
pro.fine: Puntr Pro does not buy a higher ranking or prize eligibility. Tipster Support is unlocked by verified performance, never by payment.
pro.f6: Tipster Support extras: back up to 10 tipsters at once and keep 100% of the PuntPoints supporters send you (10% platform fee on the free plan). Points, not cash.

annualPass.title: Founding Annual Pass
annualPass.description: 12 months of Puntr Pro. One payment, no automatic renewal. Your 12 months start on launch day, 1 December 2026.
annualPass.fine: Reserving is free on Puntr. We then email you a secure PayFast link: pay the R299 within 48 hours to confirm your place, or the reservation lapses and the place is released.

referral.title: Earn 10–30% recurring commission on eligible Puntr Pro referrals.
referral.body: Share Puntr with your community. When an eligible referral becomes a paying Pro subscriber, you can earn recurring commission under the programme terms.
